class.name: MaszynaFileIndexer
class.brief_description: Finds the original's data files whatever the case of their names, and keeps what a scenery's loading found and missed.
class.description: The original's data is made on Windows, whose filesystem ignores letter case, and names its files in any case ([code]glinojeck/glinojeck.ctr[/code] for [code]glinojeck/Glinojeck.ctr[/code]). On a filesystem that keeps the case, [method path_resolve] finds a path not found as written nor in lowercase: its directory, found the same way, is listed once and its names kept, and the name is looked up there whatever its case. A directory is listed at most once a run, until the game directory changes: a file added meanwhile is found in the next run. On Windows the filesystem finds them itself. The indexer also keeps what a scenery's loading found of the data since [method files_clear]: the files found, and the files its readers gave up on ([method missing_file_add]) - a reader tries candidates (a model's two extensions, a texture's four places), and only it knows when none was there.

method.name: files_clear
method.description: Forgets the files found and given up on so far; a scenery's compilation calls it before it reads the data.

method.name: found_files_get_count
method.description: How many files [method path_resolve] has found since [method files_clear].

method.name: missing_file_add
method.description: Records [param path] as a file a reader gave up on, as a file of [param type]; a path under the game directory is kept relative to it.

method.name: missing_files_get
method.description: The files given up on since [method files_clear]: their paths, relative to the game directory when they are under it, to their [enum FileType].

method.name: path_resolve
method.description: [param relative_path] as it is on disk under [param base_dir], whatever the case of its names; as written when it is nowhere.
